H3467: properly, to be open, wide or free, i.e. (by implication) to be safe; causatively, to free or succor

H3426: there is or are (or any other form of the verb to be, as may suit the connection)

H7451: bad or (as noun) evil (natural or moral)
H2502: to pull off; hence (intensively) to strip, (reflex.) to depart; by implication, to deliver, equip (for fight); present, strengthen

H7429: to tread upon (as a potter, in walking or abusively)
H776: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)

H3519: properly, weight, but only figuratively in a good sense, splendor or copiousness
H6083: dust (as powdered or gray); hence, clay, earth, mud

H6965: to rise (in various applications, literal, figurative, intensive and causative)

H5375: to lift, in a great variety of applications, literal and figurative, absolute and relative
H413: near, with or among; often in general, to

H5712: a stated assemblage (specifically, a concourse, or generally, a family or crowd)

H5971: a people (as a congregated unit); specifically, a tribe (as those of Israel); hence (collectively) troops or attendants; figuratively, a flock

H3629: a kidney (as an essential organ); figuratively, the mind (as the interior self)

H410: strength; as adjective, mighty; especially the Almighty (but used also of any deity)
H2194: properly, to foam at the mouth, i.e. to be enraged

H3808: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
H2719: drought; also a cutting instrument (from its destructive effect), as a knife, sword, or other sharp implement

H7198: a bow, forshooting (hence, figuratively, strength) or the iris
H1869: to tread; by implication, to walk; also to string abow (by treading on it in bending)

H6466: to do or make (systematically and habitually), especially to practise

H205: strictly nothingness; also trouble. vanity, wickedness; specifically an idol
H2029: to be (or become) pregnant, conceive (literally or figuratively)
H5999: toil, i.e. wearing effort; hence, worry, wheth. of body or mind
H3205: to bear young; causatively, to beget; medically, to act as midwife; specifically, to show lineage
H8267: an untruth; by implication, a sham (often adverbial)

H2658: properly, to pry into; by implication, to delve, to explore
H5307: to fall, in a great variety of applications (intransitive or causative, literal or figurative)
H7845: a pit (especially as a trap); figuratively, destruction
H7218: the head (as most easily shaken), whether literal or figurative (in many applications, of place, time, rank, itc.)
H6936: the crown of the head (as the part most bowed)
H2555: violence; by implication, wrong; by meton. unjust gain

H8034: an appellation, as amark or memorial of individuality; by implication honor, authority, character
H5945: an elevation, i.e. (adj.) lofty (compar.); as title, the Supreme
